options.reason: No column is a plausible outcome: InvoiceNo/StockCode/Description are high-cardinality keys or descriptors, Quantity and UnitPrice are transactional measurements, and CustomerID is the source unit. The evident aim (online retail, UCI) is customer segmentation via RFM-style aggregation, so rows are rolled up per customer and clustered; InvoiceDate is used only to compute recency relative to an observation date, so no chronological partition column is declared and CustomerID must be held whole across folds.
options.title: clustering
